risks.title: Decreased Leasing Demand for Communications Infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: A significant reduction in leasing demand would materially and adversely affect business and operating results. Risk is driven by wireless/cloud provider capex decisions, communications service provider consolidation, economic conditions, and technological changes including AI and RAN sharing. Citation: "We own and operate data center facilities and related assets in the United States, which". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Significant decrease in leasing demand for communications infrastructure could materially impact business and operating results due to economic conditions, carrier consolidation, technology shifts, or spectrum licensing changes.

risks.title: Litiges et différends avec les clients
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing disputes with major customers (AT&T Mexico representing ~$300M annual revenue, DISH representing ~2% of total property revenue) present material financial and operational risks, with potential negative impact on results and reputation. Citation: "Services Operations We offer tower-related services in the United States, including site application, zoning and". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Current arbitration with AT&T Mexico over lease payment calculations and DISH contract disputes could result in material revenue loss, accounting reserves, and operational disruption.

risks.title: Risque de concentration client
risks.score_rationale: Heavy dependence on wireless carriers and communications service providers creates concentration risk. Loss of major customer would have material negative impact on revenues and business continuity. Citation: "We believe that, in certain international markets, we can create value by expanding our existing". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Concentration of customer base among wireless carriers and communications service providers increases revenue volatility and downside risk from individual customer loss or consolidation.

risks.title: Concurrence accrue
risks.score_rationale: Growing competition in communications infrastructure could pressure lease rates, margins, and customer retention, particularly from alternative infrastructure providers and network sharing arrangements. Citation: "We also analyze (i) the competitiveness of the country s wireless market and (ii) how". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Increased competition in communications infrastructure leasing could result in downward pricing pressure and reduced growth opportunities.

risks.title: Technological Disruption
risks.score_rationale: Emerging technologies including AI, satellite communications, RAN sharing, and wireless equipment changes could reduce demand for traditional tower infrastructure and accelerate infrastructure obsolescence. Citation: "As a result, we anticipate growing demand for our communications sites because they are attractively". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Technological advancements including artificial intelligence, satellite technology, and RAN sharing among wireless providers could reduce customer demand for traditional communications infrastructure.

risks.title: Activités de désinvestissement et transitions de portefeuille
risks.score_rationale: Recent divestitures (South Africa Fiber in 2025, ATC TIPL in 2024) create transition execution risk and potential asset value realization challenges, though currently limited impact. Citation: "In addition to the communications sites in our portfolio, we manage rooftop and tower sites". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Ongoing portfolio optimization through divestitures could create execution risks and affect revenue continuity during transition periods.

risks.title: Risques réglementaires et de conformité
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes affecting zoning, environmental rules, spectrum licensing, taxation, and REIT compliance requirements could increase operating costs and limit business expansion. Citation: "In addition, we are subject to risks related to our international operations, as set forth". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Changes in zoning, environmental, health, tax, and REIT regulations could increase costs and restrict business operations and growth.

company_description: American Tower Corporation is one of the largest global real estate investment trusts. It is a leading independent owner, operator and developer of multitenant communications real estate. The Company's primary business is the leasing of space on communications sites to wireless service providers, radio and television broadcast companies, wireless data providers, government agencies and municipalities and tenants in a few other industries. The Company refers to this business, inclusive of its data center business discussed below, as its property operations. Additionally, the Company offers tower-related services in the United States, which the Company refers to as its services operations. These services include site application, zoning and permitting, structural and mount analyses, and construction management services, together with program management offerings that support customer deployment needs from project scoping through construction. The Company's services operations primarily support the Company's site leasing business, including through the addition of new tenants and equipment on its sites. risks_rationale_overrides.title: Technological Disruption
risks_rationale_overrides.score_rationale: Ce risque est positionné en #5 sur 7 dans l'Item 1A (Position : moyenne), ce qui indique une priorité modérée. L'intensité du langage est modérée avec l'usage de "could reduce", suggérant un impact possible mais non certain (Intensité : moyen). Le risque est nouveau par rapport à l'année précédente, ce qui montre une émergence thématique (Trend : nouveau). La catégorie technologique a un poids faible par rapport aux risques réglementaires ou cyber (Weight : bas), ce qui limite son score malgré sa pertinence stratégique.

risks_rationale_overrides.title: Decreased Leasing Demand for Communications Infrastructure
risks_rationale_overrides.score_rationale: Ce risque est classé en position #1 sur 7 dans l'Item 1A, indiquant une priorité élevée (1). L'intensité du langage est forte avec l'expression "could materially impact", signalant un impact significatif (2). Le risque est stable par rapport à l'année précédente, sans aggravation ni atténuation notable (3). La catégorie "Demand" a un poids modéré, inférieur aux risques cyber ou réglementaires mais pertinent pour le modèle économique (4).

risks_rationale_overrides.title: Customer Disputes and Litigation
risks_rationale_overrides.score_rationale: Ce risque est classé #2 sur 7 dans l'Item 1A, indiquant une importance élevée (1). L'intensité du langage est forte avec 'could result in material revenue loss' (2). Il s'agit d'un risque aggravé par rapport à l'année précédente, notamment avec l'arbitrage actuel avec AT&T Mexico (3). La catégorie 'Litige' a un weight moyen, inférieur aux risques cyber ou réglementaires (4).

risks_rationale_overrides.title: Customer Concentration Risk
risks_rationale_overrides.score_rationale: Ce risque est positionné en #3 sur 7 dans l'Item 1A (1), indiquant une importance modérée. L'intensité du langage est moyenne avec "increases revenue volatility" (2). Le risque est stable par rapport à l'année précédente (3). La catégorie Crédit a un weight moyen, bien que la concentration clientèle soit stratégique (4). Score justifié à 3/5.

risks_rationale_overrides.title: Increased Competition
risks_rationale_overrides.score_rationale: Ce risque est positionné en #4 sur 7 dans l'Item 1A (Position : moyenne). L'intensité du langage est modérée avec "could result in" (Intensité : moyen). Il est stable par rapport à l'année précédente (Trend : stable). La catégorie Concurrence a un poids faible versus cyber ou réglementaire (Weight : bas). Ces éléments expliquent le score de 3/5.

risks_rationale_overrides.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks

Citation: "communications infrastructure would materially and adversely affect our business, results of operations or financial condition".
risks_rationale_fr.2: Forte dépendance aux opérateurs télécoms crée un risque de concentration. La perte d'un client majeur aurait un impact négatif matériel sur revenus et activité. risks_rationale_fr.4: Technologies émergentes (IA, satellite, RAN sharing, équipements wireless) pourraient réduire la demande pour les tours traditionnelles et accélérer l'obsolescence. Citation: "Increasing competition within our industries may materially and adversely affect our revenue".

risks_rationale_fr.6: Évolutions réglementaires (zoning, environnement, licences spectre, fiscalité, REIT) pourraient accroître coûts opérationnels et limiter l'expansion. Citation: "demand for our communications infrastructure and may materially and adversely affect our growth and revenues".

ai_positioning_fr.summary_fr: American Tower Corporation reconnaît l'intelligence artificielle et les évolutions technologiques comme facteurs de risque émergents susceptibles d'influencer la demande des clients pour les infrastructures de communication et les stratégies de déploiement de réseau. L'IA est mentionnée dans le contexte des risques de perturbation technologique, y compris les changements potentiels des équipements sans fil, l'adoption du partage RAN et les schémas de déploiement de réseau.

evidence_fr.text_fr: Les facteurs qui influencent la demande de leasing comprennent 'les évolutions technologiques, dont l'intelligence artificielle (IA), les changements d'équipements sans fil, la technologie satellite et une hausse de l'utilisation du partage du réseau d'accès radio (RAN) parmi les fournisseurs de services sans fil'
evidence_fr.source: Factors affecting leasing demand include 'technological changes, including artificial intelligence (AI), wireless equipment changes, satellite technology and an increase in the use of radio access network (RAN) sharing among wireless service providers'

evidence_fr.text_fr: Le 10-K 2024 mentionne l'utilisation d'analytique et d'IA pour l'efficacité énergétique et la maintenance prédictive des tours cellulaires.
evidence_fr.source: 10-K exercice 2024: use of analytics/AI for energy efficiency and predictive tower maintenance

ai_positioning_override._reason: Stance "emerging_risk" hors mapping UI (4 canoniques uniquement). Remappée vers "cautious" selon intensité contenu (score=3).
ai_positioning_override._evidence_lang_note: Evidence ou summary en anglais brut, traduction FR recommandée.

enrich_ai_pos.summary: Le secteur Real Estate Investment Trusts n'est pas significativement transformé par l'IA aujourd'hui : la valeur de American Tower Corporation s'évalue principalement sur les fondamentaux propres au secteur (positionnement, marges, cycle, génération de cash). Une analyse fine de l'usage interne de l'IA (optimisation de processus, gestion d'actifs, automation) sera ajoutée en V2.0.
evidence: American Tower Corporation opère dans un sous-secteur (Real Estate Investment Trusts) où l'IA reste à ce jour un outil interne plutôt qu'un facteur de différenciation produit.
Les KPIs de la fiche (revenus, marges, ranks sectoriels) restent les meilleurs indicateurs de la qualité d'investissement.
Mettrik AI tracera en V2.0 les usages internes IA quand la sté commencera à les mentionner explicitement dans ses rapports.
enrich_ai_pos.source_note: Analyse Mettrik AI (sub-industry classification GICS, en attente de divulgations IA explicites par la sté)

fr.activity: American Tower exploite, développe et loue des sites de télécommunication à travers le monde.
fr.products: Elle propose des emplacements sur des tours, des structures de support, des services de gestion de site, ainsi que des solutions de centre de données.
fr.customers: Ses clients sont principalement des opérateurs de réseaux mobiles, des diffuseurs radio‑télé, des fournisseurs de données sans fil et des entités publiques.
fr.edge: Sa force réside dans la taille de son portefeuille mondial et son expertise intégrée de location et de services liés aux tours.

fr.positioning: American Tower se situe au cœur de la chaîne de valeur des REITs de télécommunications, fournissant l'infrastructure physique nécessaire aux opérateurs de réseaux.
fr.tech_products: L'entreprise possède un réseau dense de tours multitenants, des solutions de colocation d'équipements, et développe des services de gestion de site incluant l'étude de zonage, le montage et la construction.
fr.moat: Son avantage concurrentiel provient de la large échelle de ses actifs, de contrats à long terme avec des opérateurs majeurs, et d'un portefeuille diversifié qui réduit la dépendance à un seul client ou région.
fr.risks: Les risques incluent la sensibilité aux cycles économiques affectant les dépenses des opérateurs, la dépendance à la réglementation locale pour l'approbation de nouveaux sites, et la concurrence d'autres propriétaires d'infrastructures de télécommunication.

risks.title: Decreased Leasing Demand for Communications Infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: A significant reduction in leasing demand would materially and adversely affect business and operating results. Risk is driven by wireless/cloud provider capex decisions, communications service provider consolidation, economic conditions, and technological changes including AI and RAN sharing. Citation: "We own and operate data center facilities and related assets in the United States, which". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.description: Significant decrease in leasing demand for communications infrastructure could materially impact business and operating results due to economic conditions, carrier consolidation, technology shifts, or spectrum licensing changes.
risks.summary: Significant decrease in leasing demand for communications infrastructure could materially impact business and operating results due to economic conditions, carrier consolidation, technology...

risks.title: Customer Disputes and Litigation
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing disputes with major customers (AT&T Mexico representing ~$300M annual revenue, DISH representing ~2% of total property revenue) present material financial and operational risks, with potential negative impact on results and reputation. Citation: "DAS networks business, our Services and Data Centers segments, as well as most of our". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.description: Current arbitration with AT&T Mexico over lease payment calculations and DISH contract disputes could result in material revenue loss, accounting reserves, and operational disruption.
risks.summary: Current arbitration with AT&T Mexico over lease payment calculations and DISH contract disputes could result in material revenue loss, accounting reserves, and operational disruption.

risks.title: Customer Concentration Risk
risks.score_rationale: Heavy dependence on wireless carriers and communications service providers creates concentration risk. Loss of major customer would have material negative impact on revenues and business continuity. Citation: "We believe that, in certain international markets, we can create value by expanding our existing". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.description: Concentration of customer base among wireless carriers and communications service providers increases revenue volatility and downside risk from individual customer loss or consolidation.
risks.summary: Concentration of customer base among wireless carriers and communications service providers increases revenue volatility and downside risk from individual customer loss or consolidation.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Growing competition in communications infrastructure could pressure lease rates, margins, and customer retention, particularly from alternative infrastructure providers and network sharing arrangements. Citation: "As the demand for advanced wireless services in urban markets evolves, we continue to evaluate". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.description: Increased competition in communications infrastructure leasing could result in downward pricing pressure and reduced growth opportunities.
risks.summary: Increased competition in communications infrastructure leasing could result in downward pricing pressure and reduced growth opportunities.

risks.title: Technological Disruption
risks.score_rationale: Emerging technologies including AI, satellite communications, RAN sharing, and wireless equipment changes could reduce demand for traditional tower infrastructure and accelerate infrastructure obsolescence. Citation: "As a result, we anticipate growing demand for our communications sites because they are attractively". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.description: Technological advancements including artificial intelligence, satellite technology, and RAN sharing among wireless providers could reduce customer demand for traditional communications infrastructure.
risks.summary: Technological advancements including artificial intelligence, satellite technology, and RAN sharing among wireless providers could reduce customer demand for traditional communications infrastructure.

risks.title: Divestiture Activities and Portfolio Transitions
risks.score_rationale: Recent divestitures (South Africa Fiber in 2025, ATC TIPL in 2024) create transition execution risk and potential asset value realization challenges, though currently limited impact. Citation: "On an ongoing basis, we also perform a comprehensive assessment of our global operations to". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.description: Ongoing portfolio optimization through divestitures could create execution risks and affect revenue continuity during transition periods.
risks.summary: Ongoing portfolio optimization through divestitures could create execution risks and affect revenue continuity during transition periods.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes affecting zoning, environmental rules, spectrum licensing, taxation, and REIT compliance requirements could increase operating costs and limit business expansion. Citation: "In addition, we are subject to risks related to our international operations, as set forth". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.description: Changes in zoning, environmental, health, tax, and REIT regulations could increase costs and restrict business operations and growth.
risks.summary: Changes in zoning, environmental, health, tax, and REIT regulations could increase costs and restrict business operations and growth.
